install.summary: Open-source AI agent by Nous Research (MIT). The install is a script served from the OFFICIAL domain (hermes-agent.nousresearch.com) that provisions uv -> Python -> Git -> Node.js 22 -> clones the repo -> Python/Node deps -> agent-browser (Playwright Chromium). The Electron desktop GUI is OPT-IN: add `-IncludeDesktop` to the script, or run the signed Hermes-Setup.exe wrapper that passes that flag.
install.default_path: Windows: `iex (irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1)` in PowerShell — this is the OFFICIAL, PRIMARY path and works for the majority of users (overseas / unrestricted networks — the core audience). macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash`. To ALSO get the desktop GUI, append `-IncludeDesktop` to the script, or run the Hermes-Setup.exe (Windows) / .dmg (macOS) wrapper from https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/desktop.
install.official_is_a_bootstrapper: The official Windows installer is a PowerShell script served from the OFFICIAL domain (hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1) — NOT raw.githubusercontent.com, so fetching the script itself is NOT the CN blocker. It pipes only the uv installer (`irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex`), then provisions Python 3.11 (uv), Git/PortableGit (github.com release), Node.js 22 (nodejs.org), clones github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent, installs Python/Node deps and agent-browser (Playwright Chromium). Desktop GUI is OPT-IN: the script's `-IncludeDesktop` builds the Electron app; Hermes-Setup.exe is the signed Tauri wrapper that passes it. In mainland China WITHOUT a VPN the build can hang on the github.com clone / PortableGit release / nodejs.org / astral.sh hops (GFW-blocked, e.g. stuck at '0 of 0 steps'). That case is handled by the user-triggered FALLBACK in install_flow — NOT by probing the network up front (a reachable github does not predict success, and probing is unreliable on the intermittent GFW).

cli.note: The core install yields a `hermes` CLI on PATH (oneshot: `hermes chat -q "<message>" --quiet`). The desktop GUI is a separate opt-in build; primary user-facing form is the CLI (or the GUI if `-IncludeDesktop`/Hermes-Setup.exe was used).

install_flow.summary: DEFAULT: run the official installer script (works for the overseas / unrestricted majority — the core users). Before you run it, PROACTIVELY tell the user that if it fails or hangs (common in mainland China without a VPN), they should say so — and you will then re-install via the China-mirror method (the FALLBACK steps). Do NOT probe network reachability to choose a path: just default to the official installer and let a user-reported failure trigger the mirror fallback.
agent_steps: Desktop app — LOCAL machine only. If connected to a remote server, switch to the local server first.

DEFAULT — run the OFFICIAL installer (do NOT probe the network first). Windows: `iex (irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1)` in PowerShell. macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash`. For the Electron desktop GUI on top, append `-IncludeDesktop` to the script — or run the signed Hermes-Setup.exe (Windows) / .dmg (macOS) wrapper from https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/desktop, which passes that flag for you.

PROACTIVE FALLBACK OFFER — before running it, tell the user plainly (in their language): I'm running the official Hermes installer; BUT if it fails or hangs — common in mainland China without a VPN (stalls on the github.com clone or the PortableGit / nodejs.org downloads) — just tell me and I'll re-install it via the China-mirror method instead. Then run it and hand off; do NOT keep polling or running `--version` to check.
FALLBACK — run the steps A-D below ONLY when the user reports the official installer failed / hung / could not download. Same robust mirror flow, just on demand instead of by default.

STEP A — set China package mirrors as environment variables for the install session: PyPI -> `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple` and `PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple`; uv's Python download -> `UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_MIRROR=https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/python-build-standalone`; npm -> `npm_config_registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com`; Node.js portable -> `https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/node/`; Electron -> `ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/electron/`; Playwright -> `PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST=https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/playwright`.

STEP B — route git through a reachable GitHub proxy so the repo clone AND the PortableGit github.com release download succeed: `git config --global url."https://<working-gh-proxy>/https://github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"`. GitHub proxies (ghproxy-class) are volatile — pick one that currently responds; or pre-install Git (`winget install Git.Git`) so the script skips the PortableGit download, or use npmmirror's `git-for-windows` mirror.

STEP C — the install SCRIPT itself is served from the OFFICIAL domain (hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1), so NO mirror is needed to fetch it. Run `iex (irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1)` in the SAME session as the STEP A env vars and STEP B git proxy. If the piped uv step (`irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex`) stalls (astral.sh can be unreachable from CN), pre-install uv yourself first (winget `astral-sh.uv`) so the script finds it and skips that fetch.

STEP D — watch the install actually PROGRESS — if it stalls on a hop, read the log to find the blocked host and point that one host at its mirror (github.com clone / PortableGit release -> STEP B proxy or npmmirror git-for-windows; nodejs.org -> npmmirror node binary mirror). pip / npm / electron / playwright downloads follow the STEP A env vars.

BOUNDED LATITUDE + SECURITY: mirrors (gh-proxy / npmmirror) come and go — if a hop fails, find an alternative working mirror at runtime rather than giving up; you may improvise. BUT the script you run is the OFFICIAL one served from hermes-agent.nousresearch.com — do not substitute a modified/untrusted script from anywhere else, and NEVER recommend a specific commercial VPN.

VERIFY: after install, `hermes --version` confirms the CLI is on PATH. If the desktop GUI was requested (via `-IncludeDesktop` / Hermes-Setup.exe), the Electron app is built under %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes (Windows) / the app bundle (macOS).
Tell the user plainly what was installed (the `hermes` CLI — and the desktop GUI if `-IncludeDesktop`/Hermes-Setup.exe was used), where, and how to launch it.
tell_user: Which path was used — the official installer (default) or the China-mirror fallback
Upfront, before running the official installer: that they should report a failure/hang so you can switch to the mirror method
That the `hermes` CLI is the core install; the desktop GUI is opt-in via `-IncludeDesktop` (or Hermes-Setup.exe), and whether you included it
Install location and how to launch

network_requirements.note: These hosts are what the build TOUCHES — NOT a checklist to probe-and-gate on. Do NOT decide the path by testing them; default to the official installer and use the mirror FALLBACK only when the user reports a failure. Listed so you know which host maps to which mirror if a fallback hop stalls.

blocked_regions.zh-CN: The official Windows installer script is served from the OFFICIAL domain (hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1) — NOT raw.githubusercontent.com — so fetching the script itself is fine in mainland China. What the build touches and CAN stall on: the piped uv installer (astral.sh), the github.com repo clone, the PortableGit github.com release, nodejs.org, plus PyPI/npm/Electron/Playwright CDNs — most throttled/blocked in CN (os error 10054 / RST). Fallback bypass: run the official script with China package mirrors set (Tsinghua PyPI; npmmirror for node/npm/electron/playwright/python-build-standalone; a GitHub proxy for the git clone and PortableGit download) and, if astral.sh stalls, pre-install uv. See install_flow.agent_steps STEP A-D.

mirrors.github_clone: git insteadOf via a ghproxy-class proxy (volatile — verify at runtime)
mirrors.uv: pre-install uv (winget astral-sh.uv) if the piped astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 stalls
